entities.name: EPS network feature support
entities.description: Information element used by the network to inform the UE about support of certain EPS features.

entities.name: IE not included condition
entities.description: Condition when the EPS network feature support IE is not included in the message.

entities.name: S1-U data transfer supported
entities.description: Property indicating that the network supports S1-u data transfer.

entities.name: All bits zero except S1-U bit
entities.description: Condition where all value part bits are coded as zero except for the S1-U data transfer bit (octet 4, bit 2).

relations.description: When IE is not included, UE interprets it as all bits zero except S1-U bit.
Condition of all bits zero except S1-U bit establishes that network supports S1-u data transfer.
The IE presence/absence is guarded by the condition of whether it is included.
